verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt returning HTTP 200 at docs.beglaubigt.de that indexes the API documentation. An llms-full.txt carrying full doc content, such as webhook event details, is also published, along with a separate marketing-site llms.txt describing services and API integration, so an agent can be pointed directly at these files. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent corroboration of how complete the llms files are.
